summary: Innoviz Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice and proxy statement for the Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 16, 2026. The agenda includes director re-elections, auditor reappointment, and a board-authorized reverse share split at a ratio between 1-for-5 and 1-for-20. No record date or deal terms are relevant. This is a routine proxy circular for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; the reverse split is a standard corporate action subject to shareholder approval. No special-situation classification applies; the filing is routine and non-eventful.
